title: AiMag
tagline: Trading platform, like Amazon, Ebay and Aliexpress, but only with a focus on international cooperation of individuals, entrepreneurs and large organizations
description: This platform should work in all states, complying with their laws. Ordinary people, as well as entrepreneurs and organizations, can sell their goods and services directly, without intermediaries, all over the world. Both new and used goods can be sold. This will be an international site, which, with the help of AI, will automatically adjust to national languages, currencies, working hours of the seller and buyer, and automatically conduct dialogs outside of working hours. AI will also calculate the delivery of goods.
how_its_made: Since I'm not a programmer, I didn't design the software part of the project. For this purpose, I am looking for a team here to jointly try to create this project. I myself have experience in organizing various projects and also have experience in website design. So, I think that with the help of a solid team we can create something interesting.
